ControllerKind.description: Where a controller came from — surfaced so the arena UI can group baselines apart from controllers built by prior runs.

oneOf.description: A baseline committed with the case (`references/<id>.wasm`).

A controller a prior run produced, resolved from *this* host's run output dir. Local to the host that ran it — selectable only while browsing through that worker (the dropdown picks which worker contributes these).

A controller a **pushed** run produced, resolved from the backend's stored `controller.wasm`. Always selectable from any host (the backend is the shared source), so a reviewer can watch a pushed implementation play without having produced it locally.

ControllerRef.description: A controller a match can be played with, identified but not yet loaded.

id.description: The stable id: a baseline name, or a prior run's id.

label.description: An optional human-facing label (e.g. the model id of the run that built it).

MatchSummary.description: One match's result, summarized so a tournament list can show the outcome without loading (and replaying) the match. Serializes `camelCase` to mirror the `@test-cabinet/run-record` TypeScript contract.

blueFuel.description: Blue's total fuel consumed over the match.

blueScore.description: Blue's banked score (the points Blue earned this match).

detail.description: Why a controller lost on a technicality, or `None` for a clean result. This is set both when a controller failed to *load* (no match ran) and when one *forfeited mid-match* (fuel/memory/trap/contract-invalid action) — in the latter case the replay records only `Ended::Forfeit`, so this carries the reason a player would otherwise have no way to read.

matchId.description: Stable id for this match within its tournament (also the replay's storage segment): `"{redId}__vs__{blueId}"`.

redFuel.description: Red's total fuel consumed over the match — the efficiency figure that breaks a level-score draw. `0` when no match ran (a load forfeit).

redId.description: The controller that played Red (the lower-sorted id in a tournament pair).

redScore.description: Red's banked score (the points Red earned this match).

replayKey.description: The storage segment the replay is kept under, or `None` when no match ran (a controller failed to load, so there is nothing to play back).

ticks.description: How many ticks the match ran for.

winType.description: How the match was decided: `swept`, `time_limit` (a decisive score at the cap), `efficiency` (a level score broken by lower total fuel), or `forfeit`.

winner.description: The winning controller's id, or `None` for a draw. On a level-score match this is the more fuel-efficient controller (the tie-break), so a draw means the scores *and* the fuel totals were level.

Standing.description: One row of a tournament's standings: a controller's win/loss/draw record.

draws.description: Matches drawn (level score *and* level fuel, or a double forfeit).

rank.description: 1-based rank (1 is best), assigned after sorting.

wins.description: Matches won — the standings are ranked by this, highest first. A win is a decided match (higher score, a sweep, the leaner side of a level-score draw, or an opponent forfeit), so the efficiency tie-break feeds straight into this count.

description: A persisted tournament: the field, the ranked standings, and every match's summary. The per-match replays are stored alongside (keyed by [`MatchSummary::replay_key`]); this record carries only the summaries so it loads cheaply. Serializes `camelCase` to mirror the TypeScript contract.

createdAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the tournament was run at.

matches.description: Every match's summary, in the order they were played.

participants.description: The competing controllers (identity only, no bytes).

standings.description: The standings, ranked by wins, highest first.

testCaseSlug.description: The test case the field competed under.

variant.description: The case variant the canonical match used.
